description: This PHP script handles the creation and addition of dynamic custom fields within the SuiteCRM platform, including setting up new fields, generating HTML for them, and updating the layout via the AddField class.

classes.name: DynamicField
classes.description: Represents a dynamic custom field setup within SuiteCRM, allowing the creation and rendering of custom fields.

classes.name: AddField
classes.description: Handles the addition of new fields to layouts in SuiteCRM, generating necessary scripts to update the user interface.

methods.name: add_field
methods.description: Adds a new field to the layout, generating corresponding HTML and scripts.

methods.name: get_script
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code necessary to update the layout in the client browser.
